chunks: And among them is Nasr bin Qabus al-Lakhmi

key_terms.نَصْرُ بْنُ قَابُوسٍ: Nasr bin Qabus, a specific narrator
key_terms.وَمِنْهُمْ: And among them, referring to the group of emissaries previously mentioned

ai.seo_question: Who is Nasr bin Qabus al-Lakhmi in the context of the Four Books?
ai.summary: Nasr bin Qabus al-Lakhmi is recorded among the four primary emissaries (al-sufara' al-arba'a) who served as the direct link between the Twelfth Imam and the Shia community during the Minor Occultation. His inclusion underscores the structured administrative hierarchy established to preserve religious authority and guide the faithful in the absence of the Imam's physical presence.
